title: Late or Missing Change Notice: Extension of a Retail Transition Supply (Formulary Benefit)
content:
**Extension clause.** Under the Formulary Benefit, a late-notice extension is added to a retail transition supply when the member was not told of the change in time. The records read are the member's formulary assignment and the formulary change notices on record for the drug.

1. The member was moved to the formulary by a sponsor formulary change (the assignment carries a formulary change date), and the records carry no formulary change notice for the drug. A missing-notice extension of **14** days is added.
2. The latest change notice for the drug was sent fewer days before its change effective date than the formulary's advance-notice period for negative changes. The shortfall is added: that advance-notice period less the days from the notice date to the change effective date.
3. In every other case, no late-notice extension is added.

The extension is added to the supply before the supply is held between zero and the formulary's maximum days supply for one transition fill.

**Advance-notice period for negative changes, by formulary (calendar days):**

| Northbridge Exclusive Formulary | Northbridge Value Formulary | Northbridge Standard Formulary | Northbridge Preferred Drug List | Northbridge Broad Formulary | Northbridge Open Formulary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 90 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Situation on record | Extension |
|---|---|
| Assignment carries a formulary change date; no notice for the drug | 14 days |
| Northbridge Standard Formulary; notice dated 10 May for a change effective 1 June (22 days of lead) | 60 less 22, which is 38 days |
| Northbridge Exclusive Formulary; notice dated 1 May for a change effective 31 May (30 days of lead) | none, because the lead equals the 30-day period and is not fewer |
| No formulary change date on the assignment; no notice for the drug | none |
